content:
Apple TV and Apple Music for Android today received major updates, both centered on home screen widgets.

Apple TV version 2.5 introduces three widgets that can bring the "Continue Watching" carousel from the top of the main tab to the home screen. The small-sized Apple TV widget displays one episode or movie, while the medium size doubles the count.

The large-sized Apple TV widget presents the first item with a larger image, accompanied by a scrollable list for browsing — tap to play instantly.

These widgets cannot be resized, matching the styles available on iOS. Apple TV version 2.5 is rolling out gradually via the Play Store.

In addition, Apple Music 6.5 is also seeing a large-scale rollout today. It's a significant jump from version 5.2, likely because Apple wants to align the version numbers with iOS (the current stable release on iPhone is 26.5).

This update adds two brand-new widgets. "Pins" offers "quick access to your pinned items," while "Live Radio" lets you play radio stations instantly without opening a dedicated tab. Together with the existing "Now Playing," "Recently Played," "Recommendations," and "Top Charts," users now have more options to choose from.

Another update this time is the ability to "share songs, albums, playlists, and lyrics to WhatsApp."
